limits: No detached gate: checks ran in the Fable worktree with its own target directory on an immutable committed tree, not in a separate checkout.
No streaming, Iggy, durable store, reconciliation or MERGE runtime; execution of any streaming-table pipeline is still rejected before a write.
Resolution-time validators are tested over field names only and are not wired into analysis.
The original Scala suites did not execute against Sail; the Rust ports and Connect-level Python cases are the executed evidence.
